experience.title: System Engineer
experience.description:
In my current position I work a lot with various technologies and tools. I am responsible for the maintenance, optimization as well as automation of an Nutanix environment. I also learned how to administrate tools like CheckMK and Graylog for monitoring and logging of the application landscape.

To do all of that I also work a lot with Linux operating systems, especially Ubuntu. In general I'm a big fan of Linux and use Fedora for my own computers. For the infrastructure of this website I use a minimal Debian with Incus as a virtual machine manager.

experience.title: IT-Specialist
experience.description:
My apprenticeship was where it all started. I rotated through various departments. I was always particularly drawn to the hardware-focused teams like Computing and Networking.

That's where I learned the most too. How to work with Linux and Windows servers, automate tasks with Bash scripts or PowerShell. Of course, I also got my hands dirty with networking fundamentals and configuring switches. Java and Python basics were part of the mix as well.

What really sparked my interest about my work in the networking platform though was the physical contact with hardware in data centers and administering our central Nutanix environment in Frankfurt along with the application landscape running on top of it. As my final project, I also set up a Proxmox cluster for us apprentices.

Looking back at the time before my apprenticeship, it's kind of wild how much I've developed both professionally and personally, and it does make me a little proud. Especially since I was even awarded the Bavarian State Prize for my graduation. c:

experience.title: Freelance Tech Writer
experience.description:
I plan to start a blog for technical writers. That's why I'm currently working on my portfolio and the underlying infrastructure to create an enterprise-level foundation to the best of my ability.

My vision is to collaborate with tech-savvy colleagues on a dedicated website to write articles about current developments and best practices in the industry, as well as about the fundamentals.

The focus is on providing knowledge to everyone for free and with low barriers to access, not on making a profit.
